reason: Both are asset-light branded fashion and footwear companies that sell through wholesale retailers and their own stores and e-commerce. Deckers' core is footwear (UGG, HOKA, Teva) with some apparel. Vince's core is contemporary luxury apparel, cashmere and leather goods, with shoes as a smaller line. The products overlap only in part (apparel, accessories, some footwear). The customers overlap only in part: performance and lifestyle footwear buyers versus premium fashion buyers, though both use department and specialty retail. This is adjacent, not a direct competitor.
